about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover Autobiography ENGINE
paragraphs: The current L460-generation Range Rover Autobiography is fitted with BMW-sourced V8 engines — a move away from the previous JLR-designed units. It uses two distinct BMW V8s: the N63 (the standard V8 tier) and the S68 (the performance/flagship tier). They're both 4.4-litre twin-turbo "hot-vee" engines, meaning the turbochargers sit in the V of the engine rather than outside it. This design has particular implications for heat management and long-term component wear — valve seals and coolant lines are the main areas we pay close attention to on both. We rebuild both to the same exacting standard. Range Rover Autobiography Engine Codes BMW N63 (Standard V8 Tier) A 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8 fitted to the standard V8 Autobiography from 2022 onwards. The N63 is BMW's "hot-vee" V8 design, with a known pattern of valve seal wear and cooling system maintenance requirements over time. We replace timing chains, valve seals, and coolant components as standard on every N63 rebuild. Check Your N63 Autobiography → [link to quote form] BMW S68 (Performance/Flagship Tier) A 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8 fitted to the SV / performance-flagship Autobiography from 2022 onwards. This is a more powerful derivative of the same engine family (shared with the Defender Octa and high-performance BMW M models). It carries the same hot-vee characteristics as the N63, with the same pattern of valve seal wear and cooling system attention required over time. We replace timing chains, valve seals, and coolant components as standard on every S68 rebuild. Check Your S68 Autobiography → [link to quote form] Range Rover Autobiography Engine Compatibility The L460 Autobiography uses two completely distinct BMW engine families — the N63 and the S68 — which share a basic architecture but have different power outputs, tuning, and some internal component variations. They are not interchangeable: an N63 ECU will not run an S68 correctly, and physical fitment differs in some ancillaries. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm: - Your exact engine code (N63 or S68) via registration or VIN - Your exact specification level - Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your vehicle This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Autobiography quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car. The L460-generation Autobiography uses BMW-sourced V8s — specifically, the N63 for the standard V8 tier and the S68 for the performance/flagship tier. Both are 4.4-litre twin-turbo "hot-vee" designs. Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your car has. How much does a Land Rover Range Rover Autobiography engine rebuild cost? Rebuilds start from £6,500, for either BMW V8 code. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote. Which engine code is fitted to my Autobiography? Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the BMW N63 or the BMW S68 before you're quoted anything. Do you rebuild BMW N63 Autobiography engines? Yes. We replace timing chains, valve seals, and coolant components as standard on every N63 rebuild. Do you rebuild BMW S68 Autobiography engines? Yes. The S68 shares the hot-vee family pattern with the N63, and we service it to the same standard. Do you supply used Autobiography engines? Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation. Can you recover my Autobiography if the engine has failed? Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking. How long does an Autobiography engine rebuild take? Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop. Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine? For most Autobiography owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Range Rover Autobiography from 2023 to present. The engine features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older engine V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every engine rebuild.
